description: This file defines the ITokenClaimsService interface with an asynchronous method to get a token string based on a username.

classes.name: ITokenClaimsService
classes.description: An interface for a service that provides token claims, exposing a method to asynchronously retrieve a token based on username.

methods.name: GetTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a token string for a specified user name.
